messages:
Nina V: opened a tiny PR to tidy Dedicated provisioning docs: add concrete autoscale examples, call out SLA wording, and include a short migration note for the old scale schema. PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/901
Carlos M: quick scan. two things: 1) the docs currently mix 'cooldown' (seconds) and 'cooldown_ms' in examples elsewhere 11 unify to `cooldown_sec`. 2) show a minimal YAML + CLI example so customers can apply the change fast.
Tess L: example suggestion for YAML snippet:
```yaml
reservation:
  name: search-staging
  gpus: 2
  tenant_labels:
    - team:search
scalePolicy:
  mode: target_utilization
  target_utilization: 0.7
  cooldown_sec: 90
  preemption_behavior: graceful
```
DevRel Sam: will add a one-file sample app demonstrating tenant_labels + fallback routing. For SDK snippet, note recent API rename: `.update_scale_policy(...)`. Proposed python snippet:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
r = c.create_reservation("search-staging", gpus=2, tenant_labels=["team:search"])
r.update_scale_policy(target_utilization=0.7, cooldown_sec=90, preemption_behavior="graceful")
```
ops-oncall: ops clarifications: `preemption_behavior: graceful` allows short drain time; `best_effort` is immediate eviction. Also clarify our routing fallback: if reservation unavailable, service attempts to route to a compatible hosted model variant for up to 2 minutes, then returns capacity errors. note: quota enforcement window is 15m for backfills. add a short Runbook link: https://runbook.redwood/eviction-fallback
Carlos M: also add a migration bullet: "legacy scale_schema v1 -> v2 rename: `cooldown` -> `cooldown_sec`; remove `batch_target` (deprecated)." Put an inline CLI command for terraform users to do a find/replace.
Tess L: legal flagged the SLA phrase "reserved capacity best-effort" as ambiguous. Proposed doc copy: "Reserved capacity SLA: 99.95% monthly uptime. Capacity may be preempted for emergency maintenance; customers will receive 24 hours' notice for scheduled maintenance." Need legal signoff.
legal-bot: queued legal review for PR 901 with priority: medium. expected response 48-72 hours.
Nina V: action items I'll take: 1) unify cooldown field to `cooldown_sec` across examples, 2) add YAML + SDK + CLI migration snippet, 3) include ops fallback sentence and runbook link, 4) add proposed SLA text and tag legal. Will push updates by tomorrow morning and request review.
DevRel Sam: thanks 1 I'll paste the sample app in the PR when ready (ticket DEVREL-331).
ops-oncall: +1; will update internal runbook after docs merge.
Carlos M: LGTM for content direction. small copy nit: prefer "tenant_labels" (snake_case) in YAML examples.
Nina V: will fix that and ping for final review. :thumbsup
